title: Copse hooks configuration (.copse/hooks.json)
description: The official schema for Copse's native hook config format. A hook maps a canonical event to a spawned command. Discovered from ~/.copse/hooks.json (always trusted) and <workspace>/.copse/hooks.json (only when the workspace is trusted). See docs/copse-hooks.md and docs/plans/hooks-and-feature-packs.md (F1).

version.description: Config format version. Optional; reserved for forward compatibility.

hooks.description: Canonical event name to an array of hook entries. Only the wired events listed here are active in this release; other canonical events are accepted but reported as unsupported in Sources.

command.description: The command line Copse spawns for this hook. Relative commands resolve against the directory of the declaring hooks.json.

onFailure.description: How a failure (crash / timeout / invalid JSON) resolves (decision 9). 'open' (default) treats the failure as no-opinion so a broken hook never wedges the agent; 'closed' blocks the gated action.

sandbox.description: Whether the hook runs inside the project sandbox (decision 7). Sandboxed by default (true); 'sandbox: false' is the escape, surfaced in the trust prompt. Enforcement is macOS-only and lands in a later phase (F3) — this is a default, not a guarantee.

async.description: Opt into detached async dispatch (decision 2). Only honoured on events whose default is blocking but that allow an async opt-in (afterFileEdit); ignored (with a warning) on fixed blocking decision events (toolGate, beforeSubmitPrompt, subagentStart).

loop_limit.description: RESERVED (parsed + validated, not yet enforced — plan row C5). Per-script auto-continuation limit (decision 5), tighten-only: will bound this hook's machine-turn contributions to min(loop_limit, global remaining). Today only the global auto-continuation budget (cap 5) applies; null (unlimited) already warns because human-in-the-loop is the floor.

timeout.description: Per-hook timeout in seconds. Overrides the dialect default (30s). A non-positive or non-numeric value falls back to the default.

matcher.description: Optional regular expression filtering which actions the hook fires for. The field it tests against depends on the event: the canonical tool name for toolGate / afterToolUse, and the subagent type for subagentStart / subagentStop. An absent matcher fires for every action; a malformed regex skips the hook (with a warning).

glob.description: Optional path glob(s) for afterFileEdit — the hook fires only for edited paths matching one of the globs. Matched against the absolute path, the workspace-relative path, and the basename. An absent glob fires for every edit.
